objective: GATE 3B: crear y disparar un canal one-shot para ejecutar exclusivamente docs/RRR/sql/RRR_GATE2_MINIMUM_DDL_V3.sql en el entorno development/no-Production. Verificar blob inmutable fc184b211d8bd311c098d09c22e84e86a59b1937, repetir preflight inmediato, ejecutar con backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate bajo su frontera transaccional canonica con rollback ante fallo, y certificar post-DDL. No DML, no semillas, no Production.
acceptance: 7 tablas RRR ausentes inmediatamente antes de migrar
permisos CREATE TABLE y ALTER dbo presentes
ejecucion mediante runner canonico mode migrate con EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS=true
rollback/fallo cerrado si la migracion o cualquier constraint falla

actions.content:
name: RRR Gate 3 Development Migration

on:
  push:
    branches: [Edarsahub_Desarrollo]
    paths: [ops/migrations/requests/RRR-GATE3-DDL-V3-20260908.execute]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: rrr-gate3-development-migration
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  migrate-development:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST: '54.39.104.176'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT: '1433'
      EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE: 'EDARSAHUB'
      MIGRATION_SCRIPT: docs/RRR/sql/RRR_GATE2_MINIMUM_DDL_V3.sql
      EXPECTED_BLOB_SHA: 'fc184b211d8bd311c098d09c22e84e86a59b1937'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}'}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - name: Install SQL runtime
        run: python -m pip install pymssql pydantic python-dotenv email-validator
      - name: Immutable blob and no-DML preflight
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = 'refs/heads/Edarsahub_Desarrollo'
          test "$(git hash-object "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}")" = "${EXPECTED_BLOB_SHA}"
          ! grep -Eiq '^[[:space:]]*(INSERT[[:space:]]+INTO|UPDATE[[:space:]]|DELETE[[:space:]]+FROM|MERGE[[:space:]]|TRUNCATE[[:space:]])' "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
      - name: Immediate SQL preflight
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY' | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr_preflight.json"
          import json, os, pymssql
          tables=['RRR_Reglas','RRR_ReglasVersiones','RRR_Eventos','RRR_Beneficios','RRR_LedgerMovimientos','RRR_ScoreHistorial','RRR_RankingHistorial']
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15)
          q=c.cursor(as_dict=True)
          q.execute("SELECT DB_NAME() database_name,SUSER_SNAME() login_name,USER_NAME() user_name,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE TABLE'),0) can_create_table,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo','SCHEMA','ALTER'),0) can_alter_dbo")
          ident=q.fetchone(); p=','.join(['%s']*len(tables)); q.execute(f"SELECT name FROM sys.tables WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ({p}) ORDER BY name",tuple(tables)); existing=[r['name'] for r in q.fetchall()]
          print(json.dumps({'identity':ident,'existing_tables':existing},default=str,sort_keys=True)); q.close(); c.close()
          if ident['database_name']!='EDARSAHUB' or ident['login_name']!='HRLectura' or ident['user_name']!='HRLectura': raise SystemExit('IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
          if int(ident['can_create_table'])!=1 or int(ident['can_alter_dbo'])!=1: raise SystemExit('DDL_PERMISSION_MISSING')
          if existing: raise SystemExit('TARGET_ALREADY_EXISTS')
          PY
      - name: Execute certified DDL transactionally
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
          EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}" | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr_migrate.txt"
      - name: Post-DDL certification
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER: HRLectura
          EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY' | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr_postcheck.json"
          import json, os, pymssql
          tables=['RRR_Reglas','RRR_ReglasVersiones','RRR_Eventos','RRR_Beneficios','RRR_LedgerMovimientos','RRR_ScoreHistorial','RRR_RankingHistorial']
          required_constraints={
          'PK_RRR_Reglas','UQ_RRR_Reglas_Codigo','FK_RRR_Reglas_UsuarioCreacion',
          'PK_RRR_ReglasVersiones','FK_RRR_ReglasVersiones_Regla','FK_RRR_ReglasVersiones_UsuarioCreacion','UQ_RRR_ReglasVersiones_ReglaVersion',
          'PK_RRR_Eventos','UQ_RRR_Eventos_Source','FK_RRR_Eventos_Cliente','FK_RRR_Eventos_Empresa','FK_RRR_Eventos_UnidadNegocio','FK_RRR_Eventos_Venta',
          'PK_RRR_Beneficios','UQ_RRR_Beneficios_Codigo','FK_RRR_Beneficios_UsuarioCreacion',
          'PK_RRR_LedgerMovimientos','FK_RRR_Ledger_Cliente','FK_RRR_Ledger_Evento','FK_RRR_Ledger_ReglaVersion','FK_RRR_Ledger_Beneficio','FK_RRR_Ledger_Reversal','FK_RRR_Ledger_UsuarioCreacion','UQ_RRR_Ledger_Idempotency','CK_RRR_Ledger_Tipo',
          'PK_RRR_ScoreHistorial','FK_RRR_Score_Cliente',
          'PK_RRR_RankingHistorial','FK_RRR_Ranking_Cliente','FK_RRR_Ranking_Score'}
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],timeout=60,login_timeout=15); q=c.cursor(as_dict=True); p=','.join(['%s']*len(tables))
          q.execute(f"SELECT name FROM sys.tables WHERE schema_id=SCHEMA_ID('dbo') AND name IN ({p}) ORDER BY name",tuple(tables)); got=[r['name'] for r in q.fetchall()]
          q.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=kc.parent_object_id WHERE t.name IN ({p}) AND kc.type='PK'",tuple(tables)); pk=int(q.fetchone()['n'])
          q.execute(f"SELECT o.name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=o.parent_object_id WHERE t.name IN ({p}) AND o.type IN ('PK','UQ','F','C')",tuple(tables)); constraints={r['name'] for r in q.fetchall()}
          counts={}
          for t in tables: q.execute(f'SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) n FROM dbo.[{t}]'); counts[t]=int(q.fetchone()['n'])
          payload={'tables':got,'pk_count':pk,'constraints_present':sorted(required_constraints & constraints),'row_counts':counts,'blob':os.environ['EXPECTED_BLOB_SHA'],'production_touched':False}; print(json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True)); q.close(); c.close()
          if set(got)!=set(tables): raise SystemExit('MISSING_TABLES')
          if pk!=7: raise SystemExit('PK_COUNT')
          missing=required_constraints-constraints
          if missing: raise SystemExit('MISSING_CONSTRAINTS:'+','.join(sorted(missing)))
          if any(counts.values()): raise SystemExit('UNEXPECTED_DATA')
          PY
      - name: Evidence
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr-evidence"
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr_preflight.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr-evidence/preflight.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr_migrate.txt" "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr-evidence/migrate.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr_postcheck.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr-evidence/postcheck.json" 2>/dev/null || true
          printf '%s\n' "run=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" "commit=${GITHUB_SHA}" "blob=${EXPECTED_BLOB_SHA}" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rrr-evidence/manifest.txt"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: rrr-gate3-development-migration-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rrr-evidence
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
